```plato

//==
// # Function-valued implicit shapes
//
// The implicit counterparts of the function-valued fields in
// `fields.types.plato`: a value that STORES the distance function or the
// membership predicate rather than storing data it is derived from. These are
// what the closed-form distance primitives and the CSG combinators in
// `implicit-sdf.library.plato` and
// `fields-implicits.library.plato` produce and consume, and they are the
// only implementors of IImplicitRegion2D and IImplicitVolume3D — a predicate has
// nothing to store but its predicate.
//
// A distance field carries strictly more information than a region: every SDF
// induces a region (inside is distance < 0), but a region cannot recover a
// distance. Prefer the SDF form wherever a closed-form distance exists.

// A planar signed distance field defined by a stored distance function:
// negative inside the boundary curve, zero on it, positive outside.
type FunctionSdf2D
    implements IDifferentiableSignedDistanceField2D
{
    Function: Function1<Point2D, Number>;
}
```
